intent: Build an email login with password reset so users can self-recover access.
notes: Concrete product feature with a security-sensitive delivery; gold written at sentence granularity.

known_facts.statement: A user can log in by authenticating with an email address and password.
A user who forgets the password can recover access through a reset flow.

assumptions.statement: Email delivery is available so password reset messages can reach users.

options.statement: Offer an email magic link as an alternative to entering a password.

decisions.statement: Store only a salted hash of the password rather than the plaintext.

open_questions.statement: Clarify how long a password reset link stays valid before it expires.
